title: Quasi-kernels and quasi-sinks
exact_target: Can every infinite digraph be partitioned into an induced part dominated in two steps by an independent set and a part satisfying the reversed condition?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 3000067 (AMR-029-0067). CC BY 4.0.
P. L. Erdős and L. Soukup, Quasi-kernels and quasi-sinks in infinite graphs (2007), Introduction, definitions and Conjecture 1.2, pp.1--2.
